rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a bridge to Nmap network scanning tools for performing automated security assessments. Supports port scanning with multiple scan types (TCP Connect, SYN stealth, UDP, FIN, XMAS, NULL, ACK), host discovery via ping sweep, service version detection, OS fingerprinting, and vulnerability scanning using the Nmap Scripting Engine. Includes input validation, network size limits, configurable timeouts, and restricted NSE categories for safe operation.
